# Original embedded notices in @pdf-lib/fontkit 1.1.1

These unchanged original comments come from the exact npm archive's unminified ES and UMD bundles. The source index records complete original member hashes, archive integrity and exact byte ranges for every preserved notice occurrence. Shared bodies are reused without changing whitespace or text.

The preserved comments include base64-arraybuffer's original notice, Google 2013 Apache-2.0 headers and the original Joyent/Node MIT line-comment block. A documentation comment describing a font's copyright field was excluded because it is not a legal notice. Component headers and their original terms must not be replaced by the root package's MIT metadata.

These are partial embedded notices, not a newly constructed full license for fontkit. The exact root copyright/permission notice remains unestablished, and full bundled-component version/source/notices and source-offer closure remain open. No package was installed or original program executed.
